page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8ia-2x.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-heavy workloads requiring dedicated graphics processing units. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor built on the x86_64 architecture, offering 32 dedicated vCPUs with a base clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance features 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

The primary accelerator hardware consists of two NVIDIA L20 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. This GPU configuration is suited for parallel computing tasks, machine learning inference, and graphics rendering. The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

In terms of cost efficiency, the ecs.gn8ia-2x.8xlarge offers a specialized hardware profile that balances dedicated AMD EPYC CPU cores with dual NVIDIA L20 GPUs. This configuration is optimized for workloads that require significant GPU memory and parallel processing capabilities without the overhead of local storage arrays. Appropriate workloads for this instance include deep learning inference, data science pipelines, high-performance computing, and 3D rendering.
